# Where a run goes on / 运行在何处延续

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`where-a-run-goes-on` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](where-a-run-goes-on.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Within finitely many configurations a run is exactly a course into a return, given by the course itself, and the laws along runs hold wherever the process can keep moving; a search over recognized moves builds one; asked of every process, a run is dependent choice.
>
> 有限多配置之内，运行恰是通向返回的路径，由路径本身给出；沿运行的定律对每个能继续运动的配置成立；测试认出移动处运行经搜索造出；对每个过程要求运行，恰是依赖选择。

## Laws / 规律

1. From each configuration of a run courses of every length start, and each is had from its start; a run from where a course leads, preceded by the course, is a run, and from where a course leads to a return a run goes round the return.<br>从运行的每个配置开始每个长度的路径，运行的每个配置可从其起点得到；从路径通向之处的运行前接路径即得运行，从路径通向返回者之处运行绕返回而行。 (`Becoming.Onward.continues_of_run`, `Becoming.Onward.unbounded_of_run`, `Becoming.Onward.reach_of_run`, `Becoming.Onward.run_of_trace`, `Becoming.Onward.run_of_reach`, `Becoming.Onward.run_of_returning`)
2. Within finitely many configurations a course as long as the list repeats one and leads to a return; so a run starts exactly where such a course, courses of every length, or a course to a return start, with no decision and no selection; with successors listed, whether one starts is decided.<br>有限多配置之内，与列表一样长的路径重复一个配置而通向返回者；所以运行恰在这样的路径开始处、每个长度的路径都开始处、路径通向返回者处开始，不需判定也不需选取；后继列出时运行是否开始已定。 (`Becoming.Onward.reach_along`, `Becoming.Onward.returning_of_continues`, `Becoming.Onward.run_of_continues`, `Becoming.Onward.run_iff_continues`, `Becoming.Onward.run_iff_unbounded`, `Becoming.Onward.run_iff_returning`, `Becoming.Onward.run_decided`)
3. Where branching is infinite, courses of every length give no run: the root of the fan has courses of every length and no run.<br>分支无穷时，每个长度的路径不给出运行：扇的根有每个长度的路径，没有运行。 (`Becoming.Onward.fan_no_run`)
4. A family keeps moving where from each member some step leads to a member; the steps within it form a process whose runs are the runs staying in the family. Within finitely many configurations a run starts at each member and stays in the family.<br>一族保持运动，指从每个成员有一步通向成员；族内的步构成过程，其运行是留在族中的运行。有限多配置之内，运行从每个成员开始并留在族中。 (`Becoming.Onward.KeepsMoving`, `Becoming.Onward.within`, `Becoming.Onward.ofWithin`, `Becoming.Onward.ofWithin_within`, `Becoming.Onward.KeepsMoving.continues`, `Becoming.Onward.KeepsMoving.run`)
5. Merging nothing within finitely many configurations, with no run given: a configuration returns exactly where a course as long as the list starts there, and each member of a family that keeps moving returns; a quantity never falling across a step within the family keeps its value, a rise needing a merge; a configuration with courses of every length that never returns needs openness.<br>不合并、有限多配置之内，不给定运行：配置恰在与列表一样长的路径从它开始处返回，保持运动的族的每个成员都返回；族中跨步不下降的量每步不变，上升需要合并；每个长度的路径都开始而不返回者需要开放。 (`Becoming.Onward.lossless_returns_iff`, `Becoming.Onward.KeepsMoving.returns`, `Becoming.Onward.lossless_no_rise`, `Becoming.Onward.rise_needs_merge`, `Becoming.Onward.lossless_unlisted`)
6. Where a test recognizes among enumerated moves a step staying in the family (some move passing wherever there is such a step), search through accessibility tests each until one passes; taking each step so builds a run as data, from the member and staying in the family, with no selection; where steps and the family are decided and the steps' moves enumerated, testing each move is such a test.<br>测试在枚举的移动中认出留在族中的一步时（有这样的一步时某个移动通过），搜索经可达性逐个测试直到通过，每步这样取，运行作为数据造出，从成员开始并留在族中，不经选取；步与族已定、步的移动被枚举时，逐个测试就是这样的测试。 (`Becoming.Onward.Later`, `Becoming.Onward.searchFrom`, `Becoming.Onward.acc_below`, `Becoming.Onward.search`, `Becoming.Onward.Finds`, `Becoming.Onward.searchedStep`, `Becoming.Onward.searchedRun`, `Becoming.Onward.searchedRun_start`, `Becoming.Onward.searchedRun_within`, `Becoming.Onward.decidedTest`, `Becoming.Onward.decidedTest_finds`)
7. A run staying in the family from every member of every family that keeps moving, asked of every process, is exactly dependent choice: a total relation has a sequence along it from every start.<br>对每个过程要求从每个保持运动的族的每个成员出发都有留在族中的运行，恰是依赖选择：全的关系从每个起点有沿它的序列。 (`Becoming.Onward.DependentSelection`, `Becoming.Onward.moveOf`, `Becoming.Onward.moveOf_eq`, `Becoming.Onward.runs_iff_selection`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. A list holding every configuration, the listed successors, a test with an enumeration, and decisions of the steps and the family are written in as hypotheses where used, never assumed; dependent choice is stated as a proposition, never assumed.<br>不加公理。列出全部配置的列表、后继的列表、测试与枚举、步与族的判定在用到处作为假设写入，不假定；依赖选择作为命题陈述，不假定。

## Does not show / 未表明

- Whether the core gives dependent choice: a statement about the theory, needing a model outside it.<br>核心是否给出依赖选择：那是关于理论的陈述，需要核心之外的模型。
- That courses of every length give a run beyond finitely many configurations: the root of the fan has courses of every length and no run.<br>每个长度的路径给出运行，不限于有限多配置：扇的根有每个长度的路径，没有运行。 Witness: `Becoming.Onward.fan_no_run`.
- Runs along unbounded configurations where branching is finite and nothing is searched (given in Lasting through EitherThroughout and a selection); the laws along runs where nothing lists the configurations.<br>有限分支而不搜索时沿无界配置的运行（Lasting 经 EitherThroughout 与选取给出）；不列出配置时沿运行的定律。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** The fan (Lasting.Fan): the root has courses of every length and no run (Onward.fan_no_run): beyond finitely many configurations, courses of every length give no run.<br>扇（Lasting.Fan）：根有每个长度的路径而没有运行（Onward.fan_no_run）：有限多配置之外，每个长度的路径不给出运行。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Lasting.lean)

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren, 12 October 2026, the goal: “move towards 100%, you can spawn a few agents for help, pick the "What would move it most next" first, and don't stop until we are 100%”. This result answers the next_delta of returning-where-the-course-branches and the second item of the next_delta of lifting-where-branching-is-finite. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): within finitely many configurations, whatever goes on without end does so by coming round; the course itself shows where it returns, nothing is selected, and going on is read off the unfolding; where the configurations are not bounded, going on without end is given where the moves can be searched, and asked of every process, that every configuration that can keep moving starts a run is exactly dependent choice. Dependent choice is the standard name; the core name DependentSelection follows Lasting's selection, a function taking a continuation at each step, not a selector.<br>Ren 2026-10-12 的目标：“move towards 100%, you can spawn a few agents for help, pick the "What would move it most next" first, and don't stop until we are 100%”。本结果回答 returning-where-the-course-branches 的 next_delta 与 lifting-where-branching-is-finite 的 next_delta 第二项。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：有限多配置之内，无尽地进行者靠回转而进行，路径本身显出它在何处返回，不需选取，延续从展开读出；配置不受界时，无尽的进行在能搜索移动处给出，对每个过程要求每个能继续运动的配置都开始一个运行，恰是依赖选择。依赖选择是标准名，核心名 DependentSelection 沿 Lasting 的“选取”；选取是每步取一个延续的函数，不是一个选取者。
